data.description:
Replace the per-TUI bespoke wrapper pattern with a first-class Conversation primitive owned by c11. Each surface hosts ConversationRefs persisted across c11 restarts; per-TUI strategies (push hooks, pull scrape, wrapper claim) capture and resume conversations. Plan at docs/conversation-store-architecture.md (post-Trident review). See review pack at docs/conversation-store-architecture-review-pack-2026-04-27T2025/ for the 9-agent review and synthesis-action.md for what's been baked into the plan vs. surfaced as operator decisions (all resolved as of 2026-04-27).

Success metric: operator closes a c11 window with 15 tabs / 10 coding-agent surfaces, reopens c11, finds all 10 agent conversations preserved and resumable.

Marquee feature for 0.44.0. Stays c11-only (not landing upstream in cmux). Lattice-agnostic.
data.title: c11 conversation store: TUI-agnostic session resume primitive

data.body: Delegator online. Plan already complete (docs/conversation-store-architecture.md, post-Trident review 2026-04-27). Status bumped to in_progress. Impl phase starting in sibling surface surface:15 (tab 'C11-24 Delegator :: Impl' in pane:4). Impl prompt at /tmp/C11-24-impl-prompt.md.

[Impl] 1. Sources/Conversation/ module + core types landed. SHA: eee5a5b7. Pushed.

Types-only commit. No callers wire in yet. ConversationRef/Store/Strategy/StrategyRegistry + four strategy stubs (claude-code, codex, opencode, kimi). Reconciliation rule + close-time tiebreaker + wrapperClaim conservatism are in Store.swift; covered by unit tests in c11Tests/ConversationRefTests.swift. CI will validate end-to-end.

[Impl] 2. SurfaceActivity primitive landed. SHA: dd10f5bd. Pushed.

Sources/Conversation/SurfaceActivity.swift: serial-queue + leading-edge 250ms debounce. Wired into TerminalSurface.sendText (input observation). Output observation deferred (documented seam) — wrapper-claim time + hook-push timestamps give Codex the mtime floor it needs for disambiguation; adding ghostty-side per-surface read-callback is a follow-up if Codex disambiguation later proves insufficient.

[Impl] 3. c11 conversation CLI + v2 socket surface landed. SHA: 43b7c83f. Pushed.

CLI: c11 conversation {claim, push, tombstone, list, get, clear}. Strict surface resolution (no focused-fallback). --payload @<path> support.
Server: six v2 methods, all strict-resolved. conversationStoreSync bridges the actor across sync v2 dispatch with 2s timeout.
Tests: ambiguity policy regression guard reproduces the 2026-04-27 staging-QA bug shape — Codex with two candidates → state=unknown → resume=skip(reason: "ambiguous").

[Impl] 4. Scrapers + privacy contract landed. SHA: 3359767f. Pushed.

ClaudeCodeScraper + CodexScraper. Bounded I/O (top-N by mtime, default 16). Filename-as-id; never opens transcript bytes. ConversationFilesystem injectable for tests. Privacy contract test uses Mirror to structurally assert ScrapeCandidate has exactly the five non-transcript fields — future schema additions that grow a transcript field fail loudly.

[Impl] 5. claude-hook session-start collapsed to conversation.push. SHA: 183a0567. Pushed.

session-start: pushes via conversation.push instead of writing claude.session_id metadata.
session-end: queries is_terminating_app via system.ping (250ms bounded). If terminating → no-op. If not → push state=ended which the store maps to .unknown for next-launch reclassification. CLI policy on socket failure = treat as terminating (never tombstone on socket-uncertainty).

Plan Q3 (hook payload routing): partial collapse, not full. The conversation.push is additive — claude-hook session-start still maintains the existing ClaudeHookSessionStore + PID + status breadcrumb taxonomy because that flow drives the sidebar Running/Idle/Needs-input status while claude is alive. Full collapse would migrate that into payload territory, an iteration not v1. Documented in commit message.

[Impl] 6. Shutdown sentinel landed. SHA: bf443eb7. Pushed.

Inverted dirty/clean: launch writes dirty, applicationWillTerminate suspends-all + snapshot + promote-to-clean. Promote ONLY after both succeed (eliminates false-clean window). Bundle-scoped + path-traversal-sanitised. AppDelegate:didFinishLaunching reads prior state and calls ConversationStore.markAllUnknown on dirty/missing for the crash-recovery transition.

[Impl] 7. Workspace.scheduleAgentRestart refactored to ConversationStore. SHA: cd92c9ba. Pushed.

pendingRestartPlans replaces pendingRestartCommands; reads via the actor and maps each ref to its strategy's resume(ref:). Returns ResumeAction. executeResumeAction handles typeCommand/launchProcess/composite/skip. Legacy AgentRestartRegistry kept in tree (still consumed by SurfaceMetadataStore validator + snapshot.restore wire format) — deletion deferred to 0.46.0/v1.1. WorkspaceRestartCommandsTests deleted; WorkspaceConversationResumeTests covers the new path including the merge-blocker ambiguity-skip behaviour.

[Impl] 8. SurfaceConversations embedded on snapshot + legacy bridge landed. SHA: 4174f74e. Pushed.

SessionPanelSnapshot.surface_conversations round-trips. AppDelegate seeds ConversationStore from the snapshot at startup; native field wins, then legacy claude.session_id metadata lifted (kind=claude-code, source=scrape, state=unknown, diagnosticReason). UUID grammar validated before lift. ConversationStorePolicy.isDisabled (kill-switch read) wired into the seed + capture paths. v1 contract: history=[] written explicitly. TODO 0.46.0/v1.1 marker for legacy bridge + kill switch removal.

[Impl] 9. Wrappers issue conversation claim. SHA: 070de034. Pushed.

Resources/bin/{claude,codex}: both wrappers add a background  call alongside set-agent. Codex wrapper's comment block rewritten to document the cwd+mtime+lastActivityTimestamp filter (replaces the codex resume --last documentation). Idempotent claim semantics. PATH-scoped, no tenant-config writes, pass-through outside c11.

[Impl] 10. Kill switch wiring complete. SHA: 577ffdf1. Pushed.

CMUX_DISABLE_CONVERSATION_STORE=1: TerminalController.v2ConversationClaim/Push no-op cleanly. Workspace.restoreSessionSnapshot branches to scheduleAgentRestartLegacy which reads claude.session_id metadata via AgentRestartRegistry — operators don't lose resume capability if the store regresses. TODO 0.46.0/v1.1 marker.

[Impl] 11. Skill update landed. SHA: 0fa297f2. Pushed.

skills/c11/SKILL.md gains a Conversation primitives section (brief, example-led). New skills/c11/references/conversation.md carries the full reference: CLI verb table, lifecycle states, capture sources + reconciliation rule, per-strategy tier table, Codex ambiguity policy, wrapper-claim flow + the four PATH-scoped constraints, jq diagnostic recipes, and the 0.46.0/v1.1 removal list. Progressive discoverability per skill best practice.

[Impl] Complete. 12 steps landed in 13 commits on c11-24-conversation-store. Pushed.

Highlights:
- Conversation primitive lives in Sources/Conversation/ as actor + per-kind strategies + scrapers. Reconciliation rule (latest capturedAt; close-time tiebreaker hook>scrape>manual>wrapperClaim; wrapperClaim never displaces non-wrapperClaim).
- CLI: `c11 conversation {claim, push, tombstone, list, get, clear}` with strict surface resolution (no focused-fallback) and `--payload @<path>` support.
- Server: six v2 socket methods (conversation.*); strategy-grammar validation on push; conversationStoreSync bridges the actor across sync v2 dispatch with a 2s timeout.
- claude-hook collapse: session-start routes through conversation.push; session-end queries system.ping is_terminating_app (250ms bounded) and skip-clears during shutdown so the SessionEnd-clears-on-quit race goes away.
- Inverted dirty/clean shutdown sentinel under ~/.c11/runtime/, bundle-scoped + path-traversal-sanitised, promoted clean only after suspendAllAlive + snapshot succeed (no false-clean window).
- Workspace.scheduleAgentRestart now consumes ResumeAction from ConversationStore; legacy AgentRestartRegistry stays in tree as the kill-switch fallback.
- Snapshot integration: SessionPanelSnapshot.surface_conversations round-trips; one-release legacy claude.session_id metadata bridge synthesizes ConversationRefs on read.
- Wrappers: Resources/bin/{claude,codex} both wrapper-claim at launch (background, idempotent, PATH-scoped, no tenant-config writes).
- Skill (merge-blocker): skills/c11/SKILL.md gains a Conversation primitives section; skills/c11/references/conversation.md carries the full reference (CLI verb table, lifecycle states, capture sources, ambiguity policy, wrapper-claim flow, jq diagnostics).
- Tests: ConversationStoreFailureModeTests maps 1:1 to the §Failure modes table; fixture-driven testTwoPanesSameTuiSameCwd_2026_04_27 reproduces the staging-QA bug shape and asserts state=unknown + resume=skip(reason: "ambiguous").

Deviations from plan:
- Per-surface output observation in SurfaceActivityTracker is wired to terminal input (sendText) only; output observation deferred. Wrapper-claim time + hook-push timestamps already give the Codex strategy the mtime floor it needs for disambiguation; adding ghostty-side per-surface read callbacks is a follow-up if disambiguation later proves insufficient. Rationale: ghostty doesn't expose a per-surface read callback at the c11 layer today; touching forceRefresh is forbidden by the typing-latency policy in CLAUDE.md.
- AgentRestartRegistry not deleted: it's still consumed by SurfaceMetadataStore (claude.session_id reserved-key validator), the snapshot.restore wire format (apply.restart_registry), and the kill-switch legacy fallback path. Removal scheduled for 0.46.0/v1.1 alongside the snapshot bridge and the kill switch — same TODO marker.
- launchProcess action variant uses TextBoxSubmit with a shell-quoted argv string (Opencode/Kimi emit single-arg argv so no shell-quoting hazard). A real subprocess seam isn't wired yet; if multi-arg argv lands later, switch this to a proper process exec on the panel.

Open questions resolved at impl time:
- Hook payload routing (plan Q3): partial collapse, not full. The conversation.push is additive — claude-hook session-start still maintains the existing ClaudeHookSessionStore + claude_code PID registration + status breadcrumb taxonomy because that flow drives the sidebar Running/Idle/Needs-input status while claude is alive. Full collapse would migrate that into payload territory, an iteration not v1.

Localization: no user-facing strings added. CLI help text and CLI errors are English-only in this codebase (consistent with existing c11 conventions); no translator pass needed.

Tests: written. Privacy contract test passes against the mock-filesystem fixture (structural Mirror assertion that ScrapeCandidate cannot grow a transcript-carrying field). Ambiguity-policy regression test reproduces the 2026-04-27 staging-QA bug and asserts the new behaviour. Per CLAUDE.md, tests run in CI via `xcodebuild -scheme c11-unit` and `gh workflow run test-e2e.yml`; nothing run locally.

Status bumped to review. Handing back to delegator.

Impl complete and pushed (HEAD a63a6f02; 14 commits; +4208/-373 across 33 files). Status now review. Spawning Review sibling in surface:16 (tab 'C11-24 Delegator :: Review' in pane:4) to invoke /trident-code-review and route synthesis-action.md per the action contract. Impl flagged 4 deviations for review attention: (1) SurfaceActivity output observation deferred (typing-latency policy + ghostty seam constraints), (2) AgentRestartRegistry retained as kill-switch fallback (TODO 0.46.0/v1.1), (3) launchProcess single-arg shell-quoting hazard caveat, (4) hook payload routing partial-collapse not full (preserves sidebar status taxonomy). Review prompt at /tmp/C11-24-review-prompt.md.

[Review] Trident pass started. 9 reviewers (Claude/Codex/Gemini × Standard/Critical/Evolutionary) running in parallel against c11-24-conversation-store HEAD a63a6f02. Review pack folder: notes/trident-review-C11-24-pack-20260427-2343/. Particular attention areas: (a) merge-blocker Codex two-panes-same-cwd regression test, (b) privacy contract on scrapers, (c) strict CLI surface resolution, (d) actor concurrency bridging in v2 socket handlers, (e) skill update accuracy. Will post next when synthesizers complete and I begin acting on synthesis-action.md.

[Review] Trident pass complete. Verdict: **rework-then-review**. Verdict gate triggered — escalating the entire batch to the delegator without piecemeal absorption, per the review prompt.

Pack: `notes/trident-review-C11-24-pack-20260427-2343/` (9 originals + 4 syntheses). Action contract: `notes/trident-review-C11-24-pack-20260427-2343/synthesis-action.md`.

## Why rework-then-review

**6 of 9 reviewers (standard-claude, standard-codex, critical-claude, critical-codex, evolutionary-claude, evolutionary-codex) independently land on the same structural finding:** the new pull-scrape rail is dead code in production. `strategy.capture(inputs:)`, `ClaudeCodeScraper(...)`, and `CodexScraper(...)` have **zero** call sites outside `c11Tests/`. I verified independently: `grep` against `Sources/` and `CLI/` confirms it. The merge-blocker fixture (`testTwoPanesSameTuiSameCwd_2026_04_27`) constructs `ConversationStrategyInputs` by hand and proves the *strategy* is correct; no production path delivers those inputs at restore time. Net effect for the operator: Codex panes never auto-resume past the wrapper placeholder, the staging-QA bug class the primitive exists to fix is not actually fixed in the live restore path, and the SKILL Codex row ("Heuristic (cwd + mtime + activity)") describes aspirational behavior.

**Verdict disagreement worth flagging.** Standard-Gemini said "no blockers" — outlier. The other five lens reviewers (standard-claude, standard-codex, critical-claude, critical-codex, evolutionary-claude/codex) all confirm the wiring gap with code traces. The synthesizer biased toward the cautious verdict per the contract; the action doc explicitly notes a defensible **fix-then-merge alternative**: explicitly re-scope v1 to "snapshot-only resume; pull-scrape v1.1," fix B1–B5 below, document the scope reduction in the architecture doc / failure-mode table / SKILL Codex row, and ship with honest capability claims. **This is the operator's call (S1 below).**

## Five consensus blockers (B1–B5)

1. **B1 — Production never invokes `strategy.capture(...)` / scrapers.** Headline finding above. Fix: either wire a `forcedPullScrapePass()` in `AppDelegate.applicationDidFinishLaunching` after `seedFromSnapshot`, or scope-down v1 with honest doc updates.
2. **B2 — Dirty-sentinel `markAllUnknown` races `seedFromSnapshot`.** `AppDelegate.swift:2357` dispatches `markAllUnknown` in an unstructured `Task` before the synchronous `seedFromSnapshot` at `:2930-2941`. If the Task lands after the seed, stale `.alive`/`.suspended` refs are restored — the exact failure the dirty sentinel is meant to prevent. Brittle even when ordering happens to land right today.
3. **B3 — SessionEnd hook key mismatch.** CLI hook sends `"reason": ...` (`CLI/c11.swift:13824`); `v2ConversationPush` reads `"diagnostic_reason"` (`Sources/TerminalController.swift:8333`). Same handler is internally inconsistent: `tombstone` reads `reason`, `push` reads `diagnostic_reason`. Diagnostic provenance silently dropped on the most informative state transition.
4. **B4 — `v2ConversationTombstone` ignores `--kind`/`--id`.** CLI requires both flags (`CLI/c11.swift:10742-10760`); handler only reads `surface_id` + `reason` and tombstones the active ref unconditionally (`Sources/TerminalController.swift:8380-8389`). Footgun: an operator targeting a stale id can wipe the current conversation.
5. **B5 — `SurfaceActivityTracker` never persisted.** `seed(from:)`/`snapshot()` exist (`Sources/Conversation/SurfaceActivity.swift:70-83`); zero callers in `SessionPersistence.swift` or `AppDelegate.swift`. Architecture doc explicitly mandates persistence. Compounds with B1: even after wiring, the Codex `mtime ≥ activityTimestamp` filter has nothing to compare against on first-launch-after-reboot.

## Five Important issues (I1–I5)

- **I1** Bool/NSNumber payload coercion bug + missing size cap in `v2ConversationPush` (`TerminalController.swift:8345-8353`).
- **I2** `--state` accepts undocumented values via silent fallthrough to `.alive` (`TerminalController.swift:8334-8344`); typos corrupt the state machine.
- **I3** `conversation list --workspace` is silently ignored (CLI sends it; handler doesn't filter). Recommend dropping the flag for v1 or implementing it.
- **I4** Stale Phase 1 resume guidance still in `skills/c11/SKILL.md:486-491` adjacent to the new Conversation section. Skill-as-contract requirement says rewrite or delete.
- **I5** Add an end-to-end Codex two-pane restore test that exercises the production path (the current fixture test exercises dead code per B1).

## Four mediums (M1–M4)

M1 double-snapshot ordering on Cmd+Q (`AppDelegate.swift:2786-2812`); M2 dedup `shouldReplace` predicate (`Store.swift:240-260`); M3 telemetry breadcrumb when kill switch engages; M4 `Resources/bin/claude:165` still resolves `cmux` not `c11` (codex wrapper already does the modern `$self_dir/c11` resolution).

## Surface-to-user items (S1–S8)

- **S1 — Verdict scoping (the headline operator decision).** Wire pull-scrape now or ship snapshot-only v1 with honest scope docs and v1.1 follow-up. Both defensible.
- **S2 — Critical-gemini's "guaranteed 1-second deadlock on Cmd+Q" claim does not appear to apply.** I read the code at `AppDelegate.swift:2796-2802` — the `Task { ... }` is unstructured and runs off-main on the cooperative pool, not `@MainActor`-isolated. The deadlock claim does not hold as stated. **However**, the adjacent concern about `conversationStoreSync` capturing a `var result: T?` mutated from an unstructured Task is **valid Swift 6 strict-concurrency debt** (`TerminalController.swift:8246-8257`). Worth tracking as a v0.46/v1.1 cleanup, not a current correctness bug.
- **S3 — Claude `/exit` auto-resume regression vs new behavior — design call needed.** Critical-claude argues `/exit`-then-restart used to auto-resume Claude (legacy `AgentRestartRegistry`) and now doesn't (`state="ended"` → `.unknown` → skip) — that's a regression. Critical-gemini argues the new behavior is correct UX ("auto-resuming an explicitly exited agent is terrible"). Reviewers disagree on which is desirable. Operator decides whether the v1 contract is "explicit exit means no resume" or whether `.suspended`/`.unknown` should be resume-eligible.
- **S4 — Codex scraper cwd filter is structurally a no-op.** `CodexScraper` sets `candidate.cwd = parameter.cwd`, so `CodexStrategy.capture`'s `cwd != candCwd` check is always false. Latent on B1: if/when the wiring lands without addressing this, every operator with multiple recent `~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl` files becomes ambiguous → "merge-blocker advisory" becomes the default for everyone. Fix needs design call (parse JSONL first-line metadata for actual cwd, with bounded-read budget — possible privacy contract concern — or accept the no-op and rewrite the policy text).
- **S5** `conversationStoreSync` 2s timeout brittleness under main-thread pressure (5 sites, 4 different timeout values). Subjective severity; consolidating now (E2 below) addresses it.
- **S6** `seedFromSnapshot` uses `recordScrape` (reconciled) instead of bulk `seed(from:)` — currently safe by ordering luck; intertwined with B2 fix.
- **S7** Kill-switch backcompat scope is narrower than `Workspace.swift:335-338` comment implies (only restores resume for snapshots already containing `claude.session_id`; new 0.44+ sessions captured under the kill switch won't resume).
- **S8** `c11Tests/Fixtures/codex/two-panes-same-cwd/` is README-only — intentional in-memory contract or placeholder for real fixtures? Operator clarifies.

## Evolutionary worth considering

- **E1** `kind: String` → enum (low-risk type safety; ~20 mechanical test sites).
- **E2** Centralize the "synchronous bridge into actor with bounded timeout" pattern — 5 sites today, 4 different timeouts. Pairs naturally with B2/S5.
- **E3** Introduce a `ConversationSupervisor` actor — lifecycle owner around the store. Evolutionary-codex argues B1+B2 fixes naturally land inside it, so the right shape for fixing the blockers may be the right shape for the next year of conversation work.

## What's clean (consensus)

- Privacy contract — honored at the FS I/O boundary (Mirror-based structural test on `ScrapeCandidate`; scrapers never open transcripts).
- Strict CLI surface resolution — clean. No focused-fallback in CLI or server.
- Actor model + sync bridge — architecturally sound (concerns are about timeout consistency, not the model).
- The four Impl-flagged plan deviations — reviewers endorse all four as sound judgment calls (output observation deferred, AgentRestartRegistry retained for kill-switch fallback, single-arg argv shell-quote OK today, partial hook-payload collapse correct).
- Skill update — accurate and complete to what the strategy code does (caveat: oversells live behavior because of B1; I4 about adjacent stale section is the real fix).

## Delegator: please decide

The operator-facing question is **S1**: rework the wiring before merge, or scope v1 down with honest docs and ship snapshot-only resume now (with B1 deferred to v1.1, B2–B5 + I1–I5 + M1–M4 still landing in this PR either way). Critical-Claude argues even the scope-down path needs S3 resolved (whether `/exit` auto-resumes is a v1 contract decision either way). I'd nudge toward **scope-down + ship**: the architecture is sound, the privacy/concurrency/CLI-resolution bones are clean, and the wiring gap is a real follow-up rather than a structural rethink — but it's an honest operator decision and I don't have visibility into the 0.44.0 release calendar.

Status remains `review`. Handing back to delegator. Full action contract with file:line references, fix directions, and source citations is at `notes/trident-review-C11-24-pack-20260427-2343/synthesis-action.md`. Lens syntheses (standard, critical, evolutionary) and 9 originals are alongside it for narrative drill-down.

[Review] Operator decision on synthesis-action verdict gate.

**Path B (scope-down + ship), with S3=No (`/exit` means done).**

Rationale (operator agreed): the architecture is sound; the gap is hookup not rethink. The Codex cwd no-op (S4) makes Path A risky in production — wiring B1 without S4 ships a regression that fires for every operator with multiple Codex sessions, and fixing S4 means a privacy-contract design call (parsing JSONL first-line metadata is a bounded transcript read; not a 1-PR motion). The legacy AgentRestartRegistry is still in tree as the kill-switch fallback, so operators don't lose capability if the new store regresses. v1 → v1.1 is a real evolution path.

S3 resolved: `/exit` followed by reopen does NOT auto-resume Claude. Legacy auto-resume after explicit exit was probably accidental rather than designed; new behavior (`state="ended"` → `.unknown` → skip) becomes the intentional v1 contract. Will document in SKILL.

**Workflow (this Review sibling executing as Fix-in-place):**

Group 1 — correctness (5 fixes):
- B2 dirty-sentinel race → AppDelegate `priorShutdown` property; sync-bridge into actor after `seedFromSnapshot`
- B3 hook key mismatch → rename hook payload `reason`→`diagnostic_reason`; add round-trip test

- I1 payload Bool/NSNumber + size cap → reorder Bool check before NSNumber; 64 KiB total cap
- I2 --state strict validation → replace default fallthrough with `invalid_state` error; mirror in CLI

Group 2 — contracts and docs:
- I3 drop --workspace flag from CLI + server + SKILL (v1 limitation, document)
- I4 rewrite stale SKILL Phase 1 resume section (`SKILL.md:480-491`)
- S3 explicit doc: `/exit` does not auto-resume by design
- Scope-down: architecture doc + failure-mode table + SKILL Codex row + plan all updated for v1 = snapshot-only resume; B1, B5, S4 marked v1.1 follow-ups

Group 3 — small (4 fixes):
- M1 snapshot ordering on Cmd+Q → drop the `applicationShouldTerminate` snapshot write
- M2 dedup `shouldReplace` predicate → `nonisolated static`; single source of truth
- M3 kill-switch telemetry breadcrumb on startup; `is_disabled` in conversation list JSON
- M4 claude wrapper resolves `$self_dir/c11` first (matches codex wrapper pattern)

Saved for v0.45 / v1.1 (explicit follow-up, not silent debt):
- B1 + B5 wiring (depends on S4 design call: parse Codex JSONL metadata for cwd, with privacy-contract review)
- E3 ConversationSupervisor as the named lifecycle owner for the eventual capture/scrape pass
- E2 ActorBridge centralization (5 sites, 4 timeouts; falls out naturally when touching the bridge for B2)

Status remains `review`; delegator owns transitions. Will post commit batch summaries here as Group 1/2/3 land. CI on push (no local tests per c11 CLAUDE.md).

Branch HEAD: `d778fc2c`. CI runs on push.

Notable findings handled inline:
- B2 race confirmed via code trace: priorShutdown decision now captured at launch, applied after seedFromSnapshot via bounded sync bridge. No more Task ordering dependency.
- I1 payload coercion: confirmed Bool bridges to NSNumber on Apple platforms via CFGetTypeID; the previous NSNumber-first cast silently coerced booleans to 1.0. Fixed with explicit Bool-via-CFBoolean check first.
- B4 nested-Optional: conversationStoreSync wraps the result in Optional; store.active(for:) returns Optional. Used `case .some(let maybeActive)` then `guard let active = maybeActive` to cleanly distinguish "store timeout" from "no active ref."

- B1: forced pull-scrape pass in `AppDelegate.applicationDidFinishLaunching` after `seedFromSnapshot`
